title: GuidedSAM-Plume: An Expert-Guided Segmentation Framework for Volcanic Plumes
title_zh: GuidedSAM-Plume：面向火山羽流的专家引导分割框架

paragraphs.en: GuidedSAM-Plume是基于SAM2的开源专家引导框架，仅需极少输入即可交互式分割火山羽流。 Quantitative analysis of environmental phenomena increasingly relies on image-based measurements. In volcanology, the geometric characterization of volcanic plumes and clouds from RGB images remains hindered by the scarcity of dedicated segmentation solutions and partially handcrafted annotations remain widely prevalent. We present GuidedSAM-Plume, an open-source expert-guided framework tailored for the interactive segmentation of volcanic plumes and clouds. It leverages the zero-shot, spatial prompt-based capabilities of SAM2. The framework was thoroughly validated on a challenging dataset through dedicated segmentation metrics and field-relevant volcanological descriptors. From minimal user inputs, it is able to significantly increase performance compared to fully automatic dedicated solutions while preserving the reliability of derived volcanological parameters. The absence of retraining requirements lowers adoption barriers within the volcanological community, and the framework's demonstrated suitability for complex, diffuse plume-shaped phenomena extends its applicability to broader environmental science domains. The re-annotated dataset, produced under the guidance of expert volcanologists within the proposed framework, ultimately yields a more standardized release. The framework and accompanying dataset are made available at https://github.com/tad-damo/GuidedSAM-Plume.
paragraphs.zh: GuidedSAM-Plume 是一个基于 SAM2 的开源专家引导框架，仅需极少输入即可对火山羽流进行交互式分割。对环境现象的定量分析日益依赖于基于图像的测量。 在火山学中，基于 RGB 图像对火山羽流和火山云进行几何表征仍受到专用分割解决方案匮乏的阻碍，且部分手工制作的标注仍然广泛存在。 我们提出了 GuidedSAM-Plume，一个专为火山羽流和火山云交互式分割而定制的开源专家引导框架。 它利用了 SAM2 的零样本、基于空间提示的能力。 该框架通过专用的分割指标和与实地相关的火山学描述符，在一个具有挑战性的数据集上得到了充分验证。 只需极少的用户输入，它就能显著提高性能，超越完全自动化的专用解决方案，同时保持所导出火山学参数的可靠性。 无需重新训练降低了火山学界的使用门槛，且该框架对复杂的弥散羽流状现象所展现的适用性将其应用范围扩展到更广泛的环境科学领域。 在拟议框架下由火山学专家指导重新标注的数据集，最终带来了更加标准化的发布版本。 该框架及随附数据集已在 https://github.com/tad-damo/GuidedSAM-Plume 上公开提供。
